this_record_executes_nothing: THIS FILE RUNS NOTHING. It is a governance record. Creating it constructs no environment, resets nothing, steps nothing, writes no leaf and starts no rollout. Execution happens only when the frozen command below is invoked separately.

authority.architect_role: gate owner and reviewer. The architect specified, reviewed and froze this stage and recorded an independent PASS; the architect is NOT the approver.
authority.assistant_role: operator. Executes exactly what this file freezes, once, and nothing else.
authority.scope: exactly ONE J9 closed-loop qualification matrix. This file authorises nothing else whatsoever.

what_is_authorised.description: one invocation of the frozen J9 runner, in the frozen environment, with the frozen argv, executing the six declared closed-loop cells and writing to the single frozen leaf
what_is_authorised.retry: NONE. Whatever the outcome, there is no second attempt, no alternate leaf, no changed argument and no autonomous recovery.

frozen_inputs_note: a pure path -> sha256 map, relative to the V26C validation root. Any byte of difference invalidates this authorisation.

operational_actor.read_only: the actor is loaded read-only. It is never copied, edited, re-derived, re-fitted or projected. Its hash is verified before AND after the matrix by the runner itself.

frozen_execution.argv_note: argv[0] is the script path RELATIVE to the frozen cwd, exactly as the architect specified. Resolved against that cwd it is the absolute path below.
frozen_execution.no_progress_flag: NOT passed. Per-cell progress output is enabled.
frozen_execution.output_root_override: MUST BE UNSET. The authorised matrix refuses to run while it is set; the override exists for synthetic isolated tests only and always marks a result non-authoritative.
frozen_execution.no_other_flag: no flag may be added, removed or altered

matrix_policy.order: A, B, C, D, E, F, frozen
matrix_policy.all_six_cells_continue_after_a_behaviour: a behavioural FAIL in any cell is PRESERVED and the remaining cells STILL RUN. The matrix is executed as one declared block.
matrix_policy.aggregate_pass_iff: 6/6 cells behavioural PASS AND 6/6 cells telemetry-valid

behavioural_fail.meaning: one or more cells failed a binding behavioural criterion
behavioural_fail.expected_state: the leaf IS COMMITTED atomically with the full per-cell evidence and verdict FAIL; the process exits non-zero
behavioural_fail.action: PRESERVE the committed evidence exactly as written. STOP and diagnose. No retry.

technical_or_integrity_error.meaning: a guard, a parity contract, a reset check, a failed env.close or any other technical invariant fired
technical_or_integrity_error.expected_state: NO leaf is committed. The staging directory and the lock this run created are removed; content it did not create survives.
technical_or_integrity_error.action: STOP and diagnose. No retry, no leaf, no second attempt.

pass.expected_state: the leaf is committed with verdict PASS; the process exits 0
pass.action: PRESERVE the evidence and hand back to the architect for independent audit.
pass.confers_nothing: a PASS is a closed-loop offline result and authorises NOTHING further

a_pass_does_not_authorise: any change to FSM, morphology corridor, reward, SEA or the C++ plugin

standing_invariants.excluded: critic, PPO and any fit or weight update are excluded entirely

penetration_bands.hard_status: the SOLE binding penetration criterion: fail iff > 0.028, so exactly 0.028 PASSES
